Lines before the first snippet are not assembled.

Every reference in MSP430 code is left to the linker by GNU as, even a jump
to the label before it (see src/arch/msp430), so every snippet here checks
what rsasm resolves against what GNU ld resolves. The reference is run with
`-mP` for the polymorphic branches, which changes nothing else in a code
section.

GNU as creates `.data` before any section the source names, and rsasm creates
it when it is first used. A snippet with both says `.data` first, so the
sections come out in the same order.

=== jumps in both directions
        .text
start:  nop
back:   jz      fwd
        jmp     back
        jnz     start
        jc      fwd
        jnc     back
        jn      fwd
        jge     back
        jl      fwd
fwd:    ret

=== the longest jumps
        .text
start:  jmp     far
        .space  1020
far:    jmp     start
        .space  1018
        jmp     far

=== the longest jump forward
        .text
start:  jmp     far
        .space  1022
far:    ret

=== refused: a jump that does not reach
        .text
start:  jmp     far
        .space  1024
far:    ret

=== refused: a jump back that does not reach
        .text
start:  ret
        .space  1024
        jmp     start

=== symbolic, absolute and immediate references to labels
        .data
        .text
start:  mov     var, r5
        mov     &var, r5
        mov     #var, r5
        mov     r5, var
        mov     r5, &var
        mov     var, var2
        mov     &var, &var2
        mov     #start, r6
        mov.b   var, r7
        mov.b   &var, var2
        add     back, r5
        cmp     #back, r6
        br      #start
        br      &var
        br      back
        call    #start
        call    &var
        call    back
        push    #var
        push    var
back:   ret
        .data
        .space  0x10
var:    .word   1
var2:   .word   2

=== indexed addressing with labels as the offset
        .data
        .text
start:  mov     var(r4), r5
        mov     r5, var2(r6)
        mov     var(r4), var2(r5)
        inc     var(r4)
        tst.b   var2(r7)
        ret
        .data
        .space  0x20
var:    .word   1
var2:   .word   2

=== emulated instructions on labels
        .data
        .text
        clr     var
        inc     &var
        incd    var(r4)
        dec     var
        decd    &var
        tst     var
        inv     var
        adc     &var
        sbc     var
        dadc    var
        rla     var
        rlc     &var
        pop     var
        ret
        .data
var:    .word   0

=== labels past the constant generators
        .text
        .word   0, 1, 2, 3
l4:     mov     #l4, r5
        mov     #l8, r5
l8:     ret

=== the halves of an address
        .data
        .text
        mov     #lo(var), r5
        mov     #hi(var), r5
        mov     #llo(var), r5
        mov     #lhi(var), r5
        mov     #lo(var+0x10000), r6
        ret
        .data
        .space  0x30
var:    .word   1

=== data across sections
        .data
        .text
entry:  ret
        .data
        .word   entry
        .long   entry
        .byte   entry - entry
        .word   entry + 2
        .long   entry - 4

=== differences of code labels, which GNU as leaves to the linker
        .text
a:      nop
        nop
b:      nop
        .word   b - a
        .long   b - a
        .byte   b - a
        .word   a - b
        .word   b - a + 3
        .data
        .word   b - a
        .long   b - a

=== differences of data labels
        .data
c:      .word   1
d:      .word   2
        .word   d - c
        .long   c - d

=== a jump table
        .data
        .text
start:  mov     table(r5), r0
one:    ret
two:    ret
three:  ret
        .data
table:  .word   one, two, three

=== calls and branches into another section
        .text
entry:  call    #helper
        call    helper
        br      #helper
        br      helper
        mov     helper, r5
        jmp     entry
        .section .text.helper, "ax"
helper: call    #entry
        call    entry
        ret

=== references with addends
        .data
        .text
start:  mov     var+2, r5
        mov     &var+4, r5
        mov     #var-2, r5
        jmp     start+4
        nop
        nop
        call    #var+0x100
        ret
        .data
var:    .word   1, 2, 3

=== the polymorphic branches
        .text
start:  jump    fwd
        beq     start
        bne     fwd
        blt     start
        bltu    fwd
        bge     start
        bgeu    fwd
        bltn    start
        bgt     fwd
        bgtu    start
        bleu    fwd
        ble     start
fwd:    ret

=== polymorphic branches into another section
        .text
start:  beq     helper
        bgt     helper
        jump    helper
        .section .text.helper, "ax"
helper: jump    start
        bltn    start

=== alignment and section tails
        .text
start:  nop
        .balign 4
        jmp     start
        .p2align 3
        mov     #start, r5
        .data
        .byte   1
        .balign 4
        .word   start

=== constant jumps
        .text
        jmp     $+4
        jmp     $-2
        jz      4
        nop
        ret
